route_note: Embedding.cu (buggy 5b6caa6ba4 / fix e511672fed) copied byte-for-byte (harness/r2_extract.sh; fixdiff.py RESULT PASS, targets/pytorch-1/r2/fixdiff.check). The file is compiled whole: common/driver.cu #includes the verbatim Embedding.cu (so the kernel in the anonymous namespace is reachable) and launches embedding_backward_feature_kernel<float,float,int64_t> exactly as embedding_dense_backward_cuda does for num_indices <= 3072 && !scale_grad_by_freq. The ATen/c10 headers the file includes are the INSTALLED PyTorch 2.14.0+cpu headers (/home/fzheng4/miniconda3/envs/accel/lib/python3.14/site-packages/torch/include, git 08187d9e), used as include shim; two generated headers that a CPU wheel lacks are stubbed in common/ (c10/cuda/impl/cuda_cmake_macros.h empty, ATen/cuda/CUDAConfig.h with AT_CUDNN/CUSPARSELT/ROCM/MAGMA_ENABLED=0). Nothing is linked from libtorch: the host functions of the file (embedding_dense_backward_cuda, embedding_renorm_cuda_) are compiled but never called, and are discarded by -ffunction-sections / --gc-sections at link time, so the binary depends only on the CUDA runtime and libstdc++. nvcc flags follow PyTorch's CUDA build: -std=c++20 (required by torch 2.14 headers) -O3 -DNDEBUG --expt-relaxed-constexpr --expt-extended-lambda -D__CUDA_NO_HALF_OPERATORS__ -D__CUDA_NO_HALF_CONVERSIONS__ -D__CUDA_NO_HALF2_OPERATORS__ -D__CUDA_NO_BFLOAT16_CONVERSIONS__ -DCUB_WRAPPED_NAMESPACE=at_cuda_detail -D_GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI=1, plus $RW_NVCC_FLAGS (-arch=sm_89) and -lineinfo; never -G.

Thread-level access estimate: 64 chunks (2 batches x 32) x 1024 threads x 4 accesses (LDS dst_row, LDG grad, STS my_s, LDS match) = 2.6e5, plus leader work (~64 chunks x ~26 leader warps x 32 lanes x LDG+STG = ~1.1e5, peer accumulate ~3e4) plus 2048 index LDG + STS: about 4e5 in total (upper bound 6e5), far below 1e7.
